title: Porch Column & Front Door Stone Ideas | November 2025 GenStone
description: See real porch column and front door stone projects from November 2025. Get GenStone ideas for entryways, curb appeal, and exterior upgrades.
text: GenStone Project Highlights – November 2025 Porch Columns & Front Door Projects Amanda Lombard Director November projects focused on curb appeal and entry upgrades, with homeowners using GenStone to make front-facing areas feel more finished and inviting. From porch columns to front door surrounds, these projects show how targeted exterior improvements can make a major difference in the overall look of a home. We've Heard it All. Are GenStone panels weather resistant? Yes. GenStone panels are designed to withstand outdoor conditions including rain, snow, and temperature changes, making them suitable for exterior projects. Amanda Lombard Director Can GenStone be installed indoors and outdoors? Yes. GenStone panels are designed for both interior and exterior applications. They are commonly used for accent walls, fireplace surrounds, entryways, garages, outdoor kitchens, and exterior facades. Evan Trevenna Senior Project Coordinator How do I estimate how much GenStone I need for my project? You can use the GenStone material calculator or contact a Project Coordinator for a full estimate. Most homeowners measure the square footage of the wall area and then account for corners, trim, and a small 5% waste factor. Travis Choate Project Coordinator Do GenStone panels require maintenance? GenStone requires very little maintenance. Most installations only need occasional cleaning with mild soap and water to remove dust or debris.
